changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Persist the immutable submerchant snapshot and make existing tokened attempts discoverable.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE payments SET next_verification_at = CASE WHEN status = 'INITIATED' THEN GREATEST( CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_at + INTERVAL '35 minutes' ) ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END WHERE is_deleted = false AND status IN ('INITIATED', 'VERIFY_PENDING', 'IN_REVIEW') AND provider_token IS NOT NULL AND next_verification_at IS NULL;
